steps.step: F01.13 → F02.00 without reload, shell kept
F02.01 continue disabled until a household is chosen
F02.02 keyboard order: back → connect → name → continue → skip
Permission drawer: focus inside, Tab trapped, Escape closes, focus returns
Manual entry: NAME AN ACCOUNT → validation → save → back on F02.02
Income: non-numeric amount is announced, then recovers
steps.detail: FIELD NEEDS A NUMBERUSE A PLAIN AMOUNT.

steps.step: Recurring obligations: ADD sheet → save → listed
Priorities: multi-select (checkbox), max three, A GOAL opens the goal grandchild
Goal: name + horizon → F02.06; back from F02.06 returns to the goal
Skip: SKIP FOR NOW sheet → GO BACK keeps the step; CONTINUE skips to F02.07
Permission / consent: toggles are switches and work from the keyboard
Save / resume: reload keeps the draft; F02.00 offers CONTINUE SETUP at the saved place
Completion: OPEN TODAY needs a voice, then hands off to F03 at /today (F02 shell gone)
Start over: CONTINUE SETUP → START OVER returns a fresh setup
Error recovery: validation states render their error and the lockup
Deep-linked sheet (F02.04 validation): focus inside, error clears on input, Escape closes it
